title: Onboarding surface image harmonization and region-aware masking pipeline
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce a deterministic pipeline that produces brand-consistent onboarding and quickstart screenshots that are privacy-safe, crop-optimized, and localized. This ticket defines design patterns, templates, and heuristics for automated redaction, adaptive cropping, and per-locale overlays for the Quickstart experience across Console and docs.
scope: Design system artifacts, export templates, masking heuristics, localization variants, edge-case guidance for dynamic content, and QA criteria. Not in scope: backend storage and access controls (handled by ENG-4021).
success_criteria: One canonical template set for Desktop/Tablet/Mobile that matches brand grid and type scale
Automated redaction rules that remove PII placeholders and sensitive tokens in 98% of sampled screenshots
Cropping heuristics that maintain focal UI element visibility across 3 common screen aspect ratios
Localization overlays (RTL and long-string variants) implemented for 6 target locales and validated
Pipeline produces final assets and JSON metadata consumable by docs site and onboarding flows
design_decisions: Adopt a 16:10 master frame for Desktop exports with derived 4:3 Tablet and 9:16 Mobile crops
Prefer semantic anchors (component IDs) for crop/focal-point rather than visual centroid to preserve callouts
Masking approach: layered masks (blur + opaque patch) depending on token type; non-blocking by default
Use typographic clamps and container-aware truncation rather than fixed cropping for text-heavy modals
Include locale-footprint metadata in exported JSON to allow conditional UI composition in the docs site
implementation_notes: Provide Figma components with auto-layout variants for Desktop/Tablet/Mobile and locale overrides
Design tokens: spacing, corner radius, elevation levels must match Console v2 tokens
Annotate focal points in Figma with invisible guide components exported as metadata via plugin
Work with ENG-4210 to add a small metadata endpoint that accepts screenshot requests and returns masking overlays
Create a lightweight Node-based asset canonicalizer that applies crop/mask/overlay steps for CI
qa_checklist: Run 100 sample screenshots through the pipeline and surface precision/recall for redaction rules
Manual review pass on high-impact flows (signup, billing, key creation, model selection)
Localization QA: verify text-wrap and button visibility for fr-FR, de-DE, ja-JP, es-ES, pt-BR, ar-SA
Accessibility check: ensure exported images meet contrast for overlaid badges and labels
Regression test: confirm dashboard thumbnails match previous release visual baseline within tolerance
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (design): final templates and Figma plugin (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (engineering pilot): integrate with ENG-4021, run pilot for Console quickstart pages (3 weeks)
Phase 3 (content migration): update docs site assets and CDN manifests (1 week)
Phase 4 (monitoring): capture mismatch rates and QA feedback for two release cycles, iterate
